plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: Clouds of pale, blush-white blossoms cover bare branches before the leaves appear. Petals drift down like confetti in the spring breeze. Crowds gather beneath the trees for picnics and quiet strolls.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to early April in Japan. Blooming begins in the warmer south in mid-to-late March.
plants.location: Southern and central Japan, including Kyushu and parts of Honshu such as Tokyo
plants.funFact: Almost all Yoshino cherry trees are clones, grafted from a single original tree. That is why whole cities often burst into bloom within days of each other.

plants.name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
plants.description: Nodding golden trumpets surrounded by softer, pale-yellow petals light up woodlands and meadows. They sway on slender stems and carpet the ground in drifts of sunshine.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late February to April in Britain and western Europe, with a peak in March
plants.location: Woodlands and meadows of England, Wales and western Europe
plants.funFact: Daffodil bulbs contain alkaloids, including galantamine, which is used in medicine. The same chemicals make the plants toxic to grazing animals and rodents.

plants.name: Amaryllis belladonna
plants.description: Bare, sturdy stalks shoot up with no leaves and carry clusters of fragrant, pink trumpet-shaped flowers. The blooms seem to appear from nowhere in the warm autumn air.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late summer to autumn, roughly February to April in the Southern Hemisphere
plants.location: Native to the Western Cape of South Africa. Also naturalised in parts of Australia and California.
plants.funFact: The plant is called the naked lady because its flowers rise on bare stems after the leaves have died back for the summer.
